what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to let Uma Flowers proceed with a cannabis special permit application without a Lunenburg provisional license.
The board approved relocating the common driveway at 101 Pleasant Street, on condition that the easement cover maintenance and utilities.
It closed the hearing and approved the stormwater permit for 324 Flat Hill Road with standard and special conditions and set construction hours.
The board continued the Cross Street and Mulpus Road stormwater hearing to January 10 at 6:35 pm.
The planner will draft an amended wellhead protection bylaw, and meetings will start at six o'clock going forward.

why_it_matters: The cannabis vote lets an applicant begin the local permit process before the state step, and the planner is sending the bylaw's ambiguity to town counsel, so how the bylaw is read may be settled later.
The wellhead protection rewrite touches land use in the water supply protection district, and any amended bylaw would likely come to residents as a Town Meeting vote.
